ladrones: Ladrones is a band from Guadalajara, Jalisco, Mexico, that fuses rock/metal, hip hop and Mexican regional music into a style all their own they call “Flow Pesado.” Since 2021, their music has broken down barriers and celebrated the musical diversity of a new generation: free, inclusive and without prejudice.
With a growing audience on digital platforms, Ladrones is an emerging voice and a project with major momentum in the music scene.
maho: MAHO is a Mexican electronic music duo that performs live, made up of Gabriel Montaño and María José Garza. Hailing from Guadalajara, Mexico, the project explores house and other electronic genres, giving its productions their identity through Spanish-language vocals. MAHO has been supported by artists such as Musumeci, Alican, Jimi Jules, Âme and Dixon.

In their debut year, 2024, MAHO reached Beatport’s Top 100 with the EP “Sabes Que Sí,” released on Roam Recordings. In 2025, they teamed up with Musumeci on the EP “Me Sientes,” released on Anims (Barcelona) along with a remix by Pole Position.
yoss-bones: Yoss Bones is one of the most authentic and disruptive voices of Mexico’s new alternative wave. Her music blends raw emotion with a unique aesthetic that moves between sweet and dark, creating a world of her own where vulnerability becomes strength.

With a visual identity defined by purple tones, kawaii elements and a melancholic sensibility, Yoss Bones has deeply connected with a generation that wants to feel understood. Her lyrics explore love, heartbreak, anxiety and inner struggles, turning every track into an intimate experience.
toser-one: Toser One is a Mexican rapper who has become one of the most representative figures in Mexican hip hop, known for his direct style, authentic attitude and strong connection to the streets. His music mixes classic rap with contemporary sounds while keeping a solid identity within the scene.

Throughout his career, he has built a loyal fan base through consistency, raw lyricism and his live shows, taking part in many collaborations and projects that have made him a leading name in independent rap in Mexico.
neto-pena: Neto Peña is a Mexican rapper and songwriter known for his melodic style and emotional lyrics that blend hip hop, trap and urban music. From Guadalajara, Jalisco, he has become one of the most prominent voices in Mexico’s independent scene.

Over his career, he has built a strong fan base thanks to his authenticity and versatility, writing about love, heartbreak and everyday life. With many singles and notable collaborations, Neto Peña keeps rising as an artist in the Latin urban music landscape.
zxmyr: Zxmyr is a Mexican rapper who stands out in hip hop’s new wave for his versatile style and his ability to blend genres. His music combines rap, trap and alternative sounds, building a fresh identity that connects with a new generation.

Throughout his career, he has taken part in many projects and collaborations that have strengthened his presence in the scene, making him a rising figure in Mexico’s urban music. He is also part of Ladrones, where he brings his distinctive style as lead vocalist.
almanegra: Almanegra is a Colombian artist who has steadily built his presence in the urban scene with an authentic sound that fuses rap, trap and alternative music. His style stands out for its dark aesthetic, introspective lyrics and well-defined identity that connects with new audiences across Latin America. With constant releases and strategic collaborations, he is an emerging project with international reach.
jul-diez: Jul Diez is a Mexican artist who blends urban sounds with a fresh, contemporary approach in the independent scene. Her style stands out for its versatile identity, direct lyrics and a delivery that connects with new audiences, making her one of the genre’s most promising emerging artists.
omar-chaparro: In Mexico, he built his career hosting hit TV shows such as Sabadazo, and he is the Spanish voice of beloved animated characters like Po in Kung Fu Panda and Syndrome in The Incredibles. On the big screen, he has starred in major Mexican comedies, most notably his dual role in Como caído del cielo (a Netflix original film in which he paid tribute to Pedro Infante).
c-kan: C-Kan is currently the leading Mexican artist in his genre, with more than 50 official videos on VEVO, some of them with over 100 million views. He has headlined major festivals around the world such as Urbano Fest, Prudence Fest, Revolution Fest, the Budweiser Made in America Festival and the High Times Cannabis Cup. He has also collaborated with international artists such as Baby Bash, Frankie J, South Park Mexican, Alika, Kinto Sol and Kevin Gates.
dharius: Over the years, Dharius has built a strong presence on digital platforms, taking part in major collaborations and in the hit remix of “Por Mi México.” In 2024 he released his album “El Diablo, La Muerte y Yo,” remaining one of the pillars of Latin American rap.
keysiesm: Born on September 5, 2014, Keysie SM (Keysie Sauceda) has urban music in her DNA. The daughter of the beloved and iconic Mexican rapper Lefty SM, Keysie grew up surrounded by beats, bars and the unique passion of recording studios. But her music isn’t about repeating the past: it turns her heritage into a movement of her own, fresh and fully forward-looking.

Representing a new generation that doesn’t believe in rigid labels, in 2026 Keysie begins a new chapter at Alzada, the label where her father shined. In this new stage, she explores a versatile sound that moves freely between urban pop and contemporary R&B, combining catchy melodies, modern beats and a fresh vibe full of creative freedom.

Directly influenced by global figures like Young Miko, Keysie SM stands out for her authentic attitude, youthful style and a natural ability to connect with listeners her age. Her music reflects the energy of today’s youth: free, stylish, honest and full of rhythm.
Keysie SM doesn’t just honor her family legacy with pride; she arrives on the scene ready to make her own mark, bringing fresh air to Spanish-language urban music.
